# Shared idle thinking effect

- `source.svg` is the unchanged user-provided Duck_Thinking_Animated.svg. No public artwork license is assigned.
- `effect.svg` retains its thought-bubble paths, color, clipping and all four original six-second CSS animations. IDs and keyframe names have a private prefix so they do not collide with figure packs.
- `artwork.js` embeds that SVG as module data: the opaque figure sandbox needs no extra network/fetch permission.
- `view.js` draws only the thought bubble beside the selected body's reported bounds. The figure's body, clothing, breathing, blinking and own vocabulary remain its own.
- `idle.js` decorates the API 2 body in `figure-frame.js`. It waits 20–45 seconds of accumulated idle time, plays one six-second loop, then chooses a fresh delay. Every short click requests the same loop while preserving pointer capture and drag handling. The kit receives reaction:false on release to omit its poke bounce/jump; a sleeping/seated figure wakes quietly and autonomous walking stops. Clicks must last under 400 ms without moving more than 6 px; long presses, drags and cancellations do not trigger it. Native CSS animations stay paused; only host `step(dt)` advances their currentTime.
- Work, ask, movement, drag, sleep, pointer presses, dialogue, microphone listening, model thinking/status, explicit holds and new commands prevent or cancel the idle effect. thoughtShown is only the persistent status-bubble preference and never blocks it by itself. Active effects request the normal moving frame rate and dispose with their figure.
- This module belongs to the embedded desktop-pet runtime, with no Matter business or main-window dependency. Existing imported packs need no edits or reimport.

Checks at the desktop project root: `pnpm test`, `pnpm run check:companion`, `pnpm run test:companion`. Optionally set `MINDUCK_COMPANION_TEST_PACKS` to a directory of figure packs; the smoke copies those read-only fixtures into its disposable profile and tests them alongside the built-in figures.
